# Draft:Kotler Awards Poland

Kotler Awards Poland is the Polish edition of the international Kotler Awards, presented for achievements in marketing and management, and awarded in Europe for the first time in 2024
. The awards ceremony took place on 17 October 2024 in Sopot during the European Forum of New Ideas (EFNI [https://pl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Europejskie_Forum_Nowych_Idei|EFNI]]).
Nature and objectives of the award
The Kotler Awards recognize individuals and organizations that create innovative value for customers and achieve above-average market results through marketing activities; they also promote model directions of development in a changing market environment. The awards honor individuals and organizations for innovation, effectiveness, and the quality of management, and are positioned as an international distinction.
Jury
The international jury included representatives of academia, business, and the media, including, among other things, Philip Kotler and international experts in marketing and management. The originator of the competition was the Polish market economist Jacek Kotarbiński .
Award categories and list of recipients
The Kotler Awards Poland were conferred in two principal strands: honorary awards and business awards. Within the honorary awards, distinctions were granted to both individuals and organizations, recognizing their exceptional contributions and achievements in their respective fields. The business awards were presented to brands and companies honored for market performance, management quality, and the effectiveness and innovativeness of their initiatives.
Honorary awards
* Kotler Presidential Award – Lech Wałęsa
* Excellence in Teaching Marketing - Lech Garbarski Kozminski University
* Excellence in Entrepreneurship - Omenaa Mensah, Rafał Brzoska
* Excellence in Non-Profit - TVN (Polish TV channel) Foundation
Business awards
* Small company – Acer Inc. Poland sp. z o.o.
* Medium company – Polski Lek Maspex Group
* Large company – KRUK S.A.
* B2B – SWPS University
* Technology – Fast Tony
* Services – Mediaplus Warsaw (Group One)
* Consumer brand – Acer Inc. Poland sp. z o.o.
* Commercial brand – PSB Handel S.A. Group
* Iconic advertising campaign – Orange Polska (“Heart and Mind”)
* Iconic brand – Acard (Polpharma S.A.)
* Impact brand – FAKRO sp. z o.o.
